description: Verified Search ($0.01 USDC via x402 on Base): web search where every result is independently checked by Flow before it reaches you — the result URL is fetched live (liveness, final HTTP status recorded) and the fetched page text is matched against the result's own title/snippet terms (content-match score). Each result carries a verify_status (verified / failed / unverified_verifier_down), its httpStatus and contentMatch, and the response carries a receipt counting checked / verified / failed. Bad results are flagged, never silently dropped. The guarantee: the search is produced before settlement; if it cannot be produced, the payment is never settled. This hosted endpoint does not hold a wallet: an unpaid call returns the endpoint's x402 payment challenge itself, never an invented result. Pay it with any x402 client, or use the @flowexecutor/flow-mcp stdio package with an Early Builder Key.

maxResults.description: Max results to return and verify (default 5, cap 10)

name: flow_search
